film.title: Aliens
S: Cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, buttermilk, eggs and melted butter poured into a hot buttered pan, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, cut into squares.
spread them across the table, fingers optional
Pizza dough rolled into long thin sticks, brushed with oil, rolled in sesame and salt, baked at 220C for 12 minutes until crisp.
M: breakfast for the marines, served at dinner
Beef and pork mince with soaked breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour, mash.
the marines' first meal after cryosleep

Flour tortillas stuffed with chorizo, soft scrambled eggs, crispy potato, cheddar and salsa, rolled tight and toasted in a hot pan until golden. Dice 400g potatoes and fry in oil for 12 minutes until crisp. Slice 2 chorizo sausages and fry until the fat runs. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble softly in 20g butter. Lay out 4 large flour tortillas and fill each with potato, chorizo, egg, 30g grated cheddar and 2 tbsp salsa. Fold in the sides, roll tight and toast seam side down in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side.
W: Vanilla panna cotta set in a round mould, turned out, with candied orange peel strips as legs fanned around it.
K: strong enough to get you out of cryosleep

Strong cold brew poured over ice and sweet condensed milk in tall glasses, stirred until creamy, with a pinch of cinnamon on top. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground dark roast coffee into 800ml cold water, cover and refrigerate 12 to 16 hours, then strain through a paper filter. Spoon 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of 4 tall glasses. Fill with ice, pour 180ml cold brew into each and stir until creamy. Dust with a pinch of cinnamon.

dishes.make_ahead: Best warm, up to 1 day airtight

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C with a 20cm ovenproof skillet inside. Mix the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, egg and melted butter, then stir into the dry mix.
Carefully butter the hot skillet, pour in the batter and bake until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool briefly and cut into squares.
Heat the oven to 220C and line a tray. Roll the dough into long thin sticks.
Brush with oil and roll in the sesame seeds and salt.
Bake until crisp and golden, then cool slightly.

dishes.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk.
Mix with the beef and pork mince, egg, onion, Worcestershire, salt and pepper, and shape into a loaf on a lined tray.
Glaze with the tomato sauce and bake until at least 75C in the centre.
Meanwhile peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with the butter and warm milk.
Rest the loaf, slice and serve with the mash.

veg.n: Sulaco mess hall lentil and mushroom loaf
veg.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Soak the breadcrumbs in 100ml of the milk. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until dry.
Mix with the lentils, walnuts, eggs, soy sauce, salt and pepper, and press into a loaf on a lined tray.
Glaze with the tomato sauce and bake until firm.
Meanwhile peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with the butter and the remaining warm milk.
Rest the loaf for 10 minutes, slice and serve with the mash.
Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water and lightly oil four small round moulds.
Warm the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla seeds until steaming, without boiling.
Squeeze the gelatine dry and stir in until dissolved, then divide between the moulds.
Refrigerate until set.
Dip each mould briefly in warm water, turn out and fan the orange peel around as legs.
Lightly oil four small round moulds.
Whisk the agar into the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla seeds, bring to a simmer and cook gently for 2 minutes, stirring.
Divide between the moulds.
Refrigerate until set.
Dip each mould briefly in warm water, turn out and fan the orange peel around as legs.

dishes.make_ahead: Cold brew keeps 3 days in the fridge

steps.text: The night before, stir the coffee into the cold water, cover and refrigerate for 12 to 16 hours.
Strain through a paper filter.
Spoon condensed milk into four tall glasses, fill with ice, pour in the cold brew and stir until creamy.
Dust with cinnamon.
